About

Andrii Tsizh is a 2D and 3D animator as well as a motion designer, inspired to work on exciting projects. Currently studying at Willem de Kooning Academie, and enjoys making animation for all kinds of people.

  • Based Rotterdam, NL
  • Currently WDKA — HBO
  • Tools Clip Studio · Moho · Blender · Toon Boom · Illustrator · Unity · After Effects · TVPaint
  • Available Freelance
